shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books on weekends.
My favorite season is autumn because of the colors.
I often go hiking in the mountains with friends.
Cooking new recipes can be challenging yet fun.
Traveling to new places helps broaden my perspective.
Listening to music while studying improves my focus.
I like to volunteer at local animal shelters during summer.
Gardening gives me a sense of peace and accomplishment.
Learning a new language opens up many opportunities for communication.
Spending time in nature can greatly enhance mental well-being.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eating habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your typical daily meals?
Q2: What challenges do you face in maintaining a healthy diet?
Q3: How important do you think eating habits are for overall health?
Q4: What advice would you give someone trying to improve their eating habits?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about family entertainment activities.
questions: Q1: What activities do you enjoy doing with your family?
Q2: What are some challenges your family faces in finding time for entertainment?
Q3: In your opinion, how does family entertainment strengthen relationships?
Q4: What suggestions do you have for families looking to enjoy more time together?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What type of exercise do you prefer and why?
Q2: What obstacles do you encounter when trying to maintain a regular workout routine?
Q3: How beneficial do you believe exercise is for mental health?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone who wants to start exercising regularly?
